mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary tightening that raises discount rates for equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.25 percentage points from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE (indicating policy tightening amid labor weakness) signal imminent recession, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days through dual economic stress.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rise > 0.25pp and UNRATE rise > 0.1pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise by the specified thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months during late-cycle expansions when RSAFS declines by at least 0.3% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates manufacturing contraction that lowers corporate earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO declines by at least 0.5% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1200 thousand units signals housing market collapse that reduces household wealth and business investment, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when HOUST is below 1200.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal broad-based economic contraction that depresses corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decline > 0.5% and INDPRO decline > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO decline by the specified thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) accelerates policy contraction that reduces equity risk appetite, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS rises.
